answer_1.quote: Each entry in this dataset may involve multiple edits and contain multi-hop reasoning questions that require reasoning from 2 to 4 hops to answer correctly
answer_1.outputs: Model responses to prompts testing factual accuracy and reasoning

answer_2.quote: We utilize three metrics on this dataset: Efficacy Score, measuring the success rate of edits directly; Paraphrase Score, indicating the model's ability to accurately recall edited knowledge in paraphrased forms; and Neighborhood Score, assessing whether irrelevant knowledge in the LLM is disturbed
